prompt:
The visual shows a close-packed bubble-shooter board with colored bubbles, a marked landing target, and a visible launcher area. A shot bubble attaches at the marked target. Same-color connected bubbles pop when the placed bubble makes that group size at least three; then bubbles no longer connected to the top drop. If the launcher bubble lands at the marked target, how many bubbles become disconnected from the top afterward?
Annotation format: set "annotation" to an array of pixel-space center points [x, y] for the bubbles that drop.
Answer format: set "answer" to the number of bubbles that drop after the shot is resolved.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[483,373],[529,373],[506,413],[552,413]],"answer":4}
